Connor (Support): Escalation T-14055: trial tenant MapleSense seeing embed degradation after SSO mapping change. Their QA reports a burst of 429s + 504s during validation. Renewal review in 5 days; they're running soak tests today.
Maya (CS): Please share quick impact + whats been tried + customer contact. We need a 1-2 sentence customer note and an internal comms checklist.
Connor (Support): Impact: embed success dropped from ~99% to ~45% over last 60m. Logs show: "429 rate_limit: tenant token mismatch -> retry loop" and occasional "504 gateway timeout". Tried: rotated tokens, cleared tenant affinity cache, bumped rate limit for tenant for 15m (partial improvement). Contact: Sara Cho (sara@maplesense.ai), timezone MST.
Ari (Solutions): Likely session-affinity lost after SSO attribute mapping changed causing a spike of cold starts and KV misses. Short-term: re-enable tenant affinity and raise soft rate limits + route to a small dedicated slice for 90 minutes. Suggested route patch I can push once Ops approves.
Ibrahim (Ops): I can stand up a 90m slice (1xA10G). Will need AE sign-off to use reserved burst credits. If approved, I'll run a smoke curl and post results. Bridge created -> https://zoom.redwood/bridge/BRG-14055 (auto).
Maya (CS): Connor, draft the customer-facing blurb here (1-2 lines + ETA). Also flag whether we should proactively offer a small credit. I'll send after Ops confirms.
Connor (Support): Draft to send: "Hi Sara - were seeing elevated embedding errors after your recent SSO mapping change. Were prioritizing a mitigation (temporary affinity + dedicated slice) and will update you within 90 minutes. Apologies for the disruption; we can offer a credit for affected validation traffic." :handshake:
Maya (CS): Tweak: cc cs@redwood.com and propose a 5% trial credit. Scheduling 30-min validation on the bridge once pool is up.
Ibrahim (Ops): Provisioned slice-maple-1. Smoke test:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"smoke"}' | jq '.status, .latency_ms'
```
Result: status "ok", median latency 180ms, 20/20 success.
Connor (Support): Verified repeated calls: success 100%, latency ~185ms. Sending Maya the draft. Captured request IDs for RCA.
Maya (CS): Outreach sent to Sara (cc cs@redwood.com). Internal comms plan: 1) notify AE + renewal owner, 2) mitigation window 90m, 3) offer 5% trial credit, 4) open RCA and assign Eng owner within 48h. Marking Priority: High.
Ari (Solutions): Recommend follow-up: add a telemetry rule that flags SSO mapping changes with a 10%+ error delta for trials, and consider auto-affinity toggle during onboarding.
Maya (CS): Good recs. After the bridge paste any customer feedback here so CS can update renewal risk. Thanks team :pray:
